items.h: Stablecoin Reserve Requirements Explained
items.s: A stablecoin is a digital asset designed to maintain a steady value by pegging its price to another asset, most commonly a fiat currency like the U.S. dollar. Stablecoin reserve requirements are the rules determining the assets an issuer must hold to back up every stablecoin it puts into circulation.
